## ⚑ Check these first

### ⚑ Section A · Q2 · (a) — 1 mark

> Which animal can live in a desert?

- Options: camel · goat · fish
- **Answer: camel · goat**
- Source: Ch 5, p.3
- Teacher note: Goats also live in deserts; both options are accepted.

### ⚑ Section B · Q5 · (a) — 2 marks

> Why should we not feed animals in a forest?

- **Answer: Human food can make animals sick, and they may stop finding their own food.**
- Rubric:
  - full (2 marks): Two sensible reasons.
  - partial (1 mark): One sensible reason.
  - none (0 marks): No sensible reason.
- Model answer: Our food can make them sick and they may stop looking for their own food.
- Marking guide: One mark for each sensible reason.
- Source: Ch 3, p.6

### ⚑ Section B · Q6 · (a) — 3 marks

> Write three things you can observe on a nature trail.

- **Answer: Leaves of different shapes, footprints of animals, and insects on plants.**
- Rubric:
  - full (3 marks): Three sensible observations.
  - partial (1.5 marks): One or two sensible observations.
  - none (0 marks): No sensible observation.
- Marking guide: One mark for each sensible observation.
- Source: Ch 3, p.1

- **Answer: Bird - Nest; Lion - Den; Bee - Hive; Spider - Web.**
